name: const unsafe fn read_unaligned (self) -> T where T : Sized ,
rule: When constructing `self` to point to an unaligned packed struct field, creating an intermediate unaligned reference, as in `&packed.unaligned as *const FieldType`, is undefined behavior even if the reference is temporary and immediately cast to a raw pointer.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * mut T { const unsafe fn read_unaligned (self) -> T where T : Sized , }
